newsitem.title: GERMANY: ICE HOCKEY-GERMAN PLAYERS FREE WHEN CONTRACTS EXPIRE.
newsitem.headline: ICE HOCKEY-GERMAN PLAYERS FREE WHEN CONTRACTS EXPIRE.

text.p: Germany's federal labour court ruled on Wednesday that players in the German ice hockey league (DEL) should be free agents once their existing contracts expire.

In following the Bosman ruling, where the European Court decided in 1995 that UEFA soccer transfer fee rules infringed European Union law, the German court ruled in favour of Nuremberg defenceman Torsten Kienass.
Kienass had to help to pay for his own transfer from Berlin to Duesseldorf in 1992. He had paid 110,500 marks ($73,800) to Berlin for the move.
